result.title: Deep Mesoscopic Dynamics
result.summary: Microscopic simulations resolve spatial patterns but are feasible only over small domains and short timescales, whereas bulk descriptions erase those patterns through spatial averaging. Mesoscopic fields preserve this spatial organisation, but their effective equations are known only for selected microscopic systems and scaling limits. We introduce Deep Mesoscopic Dynamics (DeepMesoD), which uses neural networks to learn an effective mesoscopic field equation from microscopic trajectories at a prescribed coarse-graining scale. For the nonconserved dissipative dynamics studied here, DeepMesoD learns the free-energy functional with a spatial interaction kernel and a state-dependent dissipation operator constrained by the fluctuation-dissipation relation. We first validate the construction in the Ising-Kac model, where the learned mesoscopic equation recovers the known hydrodynamic limit and rollouts remain stable far beyond the training horizon. We then treat two systems without closed-form mesoscopic descriptions. For a two-dimensional Heisenberg ferromagnet governed by atomistic spin dynamics, DeepMesoD learns a mesoscopic model whose predictions match atomistic references up to 1 ns, and a rollout with an unseen initial condition remains bounded up to 25 ns. For layered CrBr$_3$, the learned kernel captures the suppression and sign reversal of interlayer coupling at a stacking fault whose location and strength are not supplied as inputs. Controlled changes to the learned interaction show how fault number and placement shape multistep magnetic responses, complementing our magneto-photoluminescence measurements. Across the two atomistic systems, DeepMesoD achieves a three-to-four-order-of-magnitude reduction in wall-clock time compared with atomistic spin dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DeepMesoD，用神经网络在指定粗粒化尺度上从微观轨迹学习有效介观场方程（含空间相互作用核与满足涨落耗散关系的状态依赖耗散算符），并在 Ising-Kac、二维 Heisenberg 铁磁体与层状 CrBr₃ 上验证，长时 rollout 稳定且大幅加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“指定粗粒化尺度上学得的状态更新算符”与“rollout 远超训练时域仍稳定”，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态抽象、推理状态更新与长度泛化的评价方式提供类比线索，具体可迁移性需核查（属推测）。
